descricao: Meta-approved message templates to start conversations outside the 24h window.

lista.semImagemPadrao: No default image: the widget and the robot will ask for the image on every send.

form.nomeHint: Use snake_case: lowercase letters, numbers and _ only.
form.exemploHint: Meta requires one example per variable. Without it the template is rejected.
form.erroExemplo: Fill in an example for every variable in the body.

botoes.hint: Up to {{max}} buttons. Quick replies are shown before the others.
botoes.urlHint: For a different link per send, end the URL with {{1}}.
botoes.telefoneHint: With country code, digits only. E.g.: +5511999999999
botoes.codigoHint: The actual code is provided on each send.

erros.buttons_not_allowed: Authentication templates do not accept buttons.
erros.copy_code_not_allowed: Copy code is only allowed in marketing templates.
erros.too_many_buttons: A template accepts at most 10 buttons.
erros.too_many_of_type: A template accepts at most 2 links, 1 call and 1 copy code.
erros.text_too_long: Button text must be up to 25 characters.
erros.url_too_long: The URL must be up to 2000 characters.
erros.url_variable_position: The variable can only be {{1}}, at the end of the URL.
erros.phone_invalid: Invalid phone: use country code and digits only, up to 20 characters.
erros.code_too_long: The code must be up to 15 characters.

cabecalho.exemplo: Public URL of the sample image
cabecalho.exemploHint: Direct https link to the JPEG or PNG file, up to 5 MB. Recommended ratio 1.91:1. Meta uses this image for approval, and it becomes the default image for sends.

erros.header_not_allowed: Authentication templates do not accept a header.
erros.example_required: Enter the URL of the sample image.
erros.example_not_https: The image URL must start with https://.
erros.example_meta_cdn: WhatsApp/Meta links are not valid samples: use the link to the image file itself.
erros.file_too_large: The sample image is larger than 5 MB.
erros.file_invalid_type: The sample image must be JPEG or PNG.
erros.default_required: This template has no default image yet: upload a new image.

cabecalho.arquivoHint: JPEG or PNG, up to 5 MB. Recommended ratio 1.91:1. Meta uses this image for approval, and it becomes the default image for sends.
cabecalho.manterHint: Uses the default sending image as the sample for Meta.

form.subtituloNovo: The template is submitted for Meta approval when you send it.
form.subtituloEditar: Changes go to a new Meta review.
form.avisoEdicao: When you save, the template goes back to Meta review and cannot be sent until it is approved again. Approved templates accept one edit per day.
form.nomeTravado: The name cannot be changed after creation.
form.categoriaTravada: The category of an approved template cannot be changed.

campanha.descricao: Each offered template shows up as a provider under Marketing → SMS campaign. Picking the provider is picking the template.
campanha.comoUsar: In the campaign text, enter only the variable values, in order — one per line or separated by semicolons. Use CRM fields so each contact gets their own value. E.g.: #LEAD.TITLE#;#LEAD.ID#
campanha.semVariaveis: No variables — leave the campaign text empty.
campanha.comVariaveis_one: {{count}} variable to provide in the campaign text.
campanha.comVariaveis_other: {{count}} variables to provide in the campaign text.
campanha.vazio: No approved template on this line yet.
campanha.registrado: Template available in your SMS campaigns.
campanha.indisponivel: Nothing changed: campaign sending is not available in this environment.
campanha.indisponivelAmbiente: Campaign sending is not available in this environment. Contact support.
campanha.erroLeitura: Could not read the templates for this line.
campanha.erroAcao: Could not change the provider for this template.
campanha.bloqueada: This line has no active subscription, so its templates cannot be offered in campaigns.
campanha.botaoDinamico: This template has a button that needs a value on each send (link or code), and the campaign cannot provide it.
campanha.cabecalhoImagem: This template has an image header, and the campaign cannot provide it.

acoes.editarEmAnalise: Under Meta review: wait for the answer to edit.

imagemPadrao.descricao: Image sent in the header of {{nome}} when the widget or the robot does not provide another.
imagemPadrao.hint: JPEG or PNG, up to 5 MB. Recommended ratio 1.91:1. WhatsApp/Meta links expire and are not accepted.

erros.example_not_https: The image URL must start with https://.
erros.example_meta_cdn: WhatsApp/Meta links expire: use the link of the image file itself.
erros.file_invalid_type: The image must be JPEG or PNG.

detalhes.descricao: How the contact receives this template on WhatsApp.
detalhes.comImagemPadrao: The preview shows the default sending image, used when no other is provided.

preview.hint: How the contact will receive it. Variables are filled in on each send.

estados.vazioTexto: Create a template and submit it for Meta approval, or sync the ones already in the account.
estados.semResultado: No template matches this search and these filters.
